name: Kong Hans Kælder

menus.name: Anniversary Menu
menus.note: Classic French cooking with dishes carved and flambéed at the table; cheese trolley DKK 325 extra; wine pairings DKK 2,400 (Renaissance), DKK 4,700 (Prestige) or DKK 8,500 (Extravagance); a juice pairing can be ordered on the day

bookingOpens: Online through DinnerBooking, or by phone or email. A booking stands once the confirmation email arrives; a week before the visit a second email must be confirmed within 24 hours to keep the table.
bookingPhone: +45 33 11 68 68, office hours Monday to Friday 9am to 3pm
cancellation: Bookings can be cancelled or reduced up to 72 hours ahead, by phone or email; one week ahead for parties of more than five and three weeks ahead for more than ten. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged DKK 3,200 a person.
groups: Private dining is available, with a menu planned with the head chef; enquiries by phone or info@konghans.dk.
